d:
Ranchi men guru nanak jayanti ke avsar par sikh samaj ki or se guru nanak skul men bhavy karyakram ka aayojan kiya gaya. is vishesh avsar par jharkhand ke rajyapal santosh gangvar aur kendriy raksha rajy mantri sah ranchi sansad sanjay seth bhi shamil hue.
Karyakram men guru nanak dev ji ko shraddhapurvak naman kiya gaya. is dauran sikh samaj ke logon ne guruparv ko shraddha aur ullas ke sath manaya. guru nanak dev ji ki shikshaon, seva, samanta, prem aur bhaeechare ke sandesh ko yad kiya gaya.
